name: Fire Bolt (Hỏa Tiễn)
rule: A plain Fire hit.

name: Kindle Palm (Dẫn Hỏa Chưởng)
rule: A Fire hit that lays 2 Burn stacks for 8 s.

name: Ember Rain (Tàn Hỏa Vũ)
rule: A fast Fire hit that lays 20 Burn stacks for 2 s: the front-loaded clock of a Burn build.

name: Flame Lance (Liệt Diễm Thương)
rule: A slow Fire hit that lays 4 Burn stacks for 8 s.

name: Warm the Hearth (Noãn Lô Quyết)
rule: A small Fire hit that gives you 3 Fire buff stacks for 15 s (each +1.2 % damage dealt).

name: Red Lotus Ring (Xích Liên Ấn)
rule: A Fire hit that lays 3 Burn stacks for 8 s on the foe and gives you 2 Fire buff stacks for 10 s: one cast feeds both sides of Fire.

name: Feed the Fire (Đầu Hỏa)
rule: No hit. Only while your linh lực is at 40 % or more: gives you 12 Fire buff stacks for 5 s, so spending linh lực turns directly into damage dealt.

name: Flare Up (Bạo Diễm)
rule: A Fire hit that burns off up to 20 Burn stacks on the foe; each stack consumed deals a Fire free hit of 0.12. The payoff for a Burn build.

name: Rekindle (Phục Hỏa)
rule: A Fire hit; whenever it crits (at most 2 times a pulse) it lays 3 more Burn stacks for 4 s on the foe. Crit chance becomes Burn.

name: Burning Reply (Hỏa Báo)
rule: Gives you 4 Fire buff stacks for 10 s. While equipped, every hit you take stokes 1 more Fire buff stack for 6 s (at most 3 a pulse): pain turned into damage.

name: Gravel Strike (Sạn Kích)
rule: A plain Earth hit.

name: Tremor Palm (Chấn Thổ Chưởng)
rule: An Earth hit that lays 2 Earth debuff stacks (-1.2 pp accuracy each) for 8 s.

name: Packed Earth Stance (Hậu Thổ Trụ Thế)
rule: No hit. Gives you 5 Earth buff stacks for 12 s (Physical damage taken 1.1 % dampened each).

name: Landslide (Băng Nham)
rule: A heavy Earth hit that also gives you 4 Earth buff stacks for 10 s.

name: Gate Hammer (Quan Chùy)
rule: A heavy Earth slam that lays 4 Earth debuff stacks for 6 s on the foe.

name: Mountain-Press Seal (Áp Sơn Ấn)
rule: A heavy Physical hit. If the foe bears 4 or more of your Earth debuff stacks it lands a further free Physical hit of 0.8; Tremor Palm and Gate Hammer prepare it.

name: Iron Mountain Shield (Thiết Sơn Thuẫn)
rule: No hit. Raises a body shield of 8 % of your health.

name: Stone Rebuke (Thạch Báo)
rule: Gives you 3 Earth buff stacks for 10 s. While equipped, a hit you take is answered by a free Physical hit of 0.5 (once every 3 s).

name: Bedrock Breath (Nham Tức)
rule: No hit. Gives you 6 Earth buff stacks for 10 s. While you hold 6 or more Earth buff stacks you regain +0.5 pp health a pulse: endurance turns into recovery.

name: Quick Draw Cut (Tật Xuất Kiếm Trảm)
rule: A fast, cheap Physical sword hit: the main source of crit rolls.

name: Notch the Foe (Khắc Ngân)
rule: A Physical sword hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks (+1.8 % Physical damage taken each) for 8 s.

name: Closing Palm (Hợp Chưởng)
rule: A Physical palm hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 10 s.

name: Peg-Line Cut (Đinh Tuyến Trảm)
rule: A Physical sword hit that gives you 4 Metal buff stacks (+1.2 % Physical damage dealt each) for 10 s.

name: Through the Mountain (Xuyên Sơn)
rule: A heavy Physical hit that passes 10 % of the foe's ward (bypass). The heavy blow of a piercing build; Notch the Foe's stacks set it up.

name: Last Stitch (Mạt Tuyến)
rule: Fires only while the foe's health is below 35 %. A Physical hit that passes 10 % of the foe's ward: the finishing stitch.

name: Thorn Chorus (Kinh Hợp Xướng)
rule: A Physical hit that deals more for every hit you have taken this fight: +5 % damage a hit, up to 10 hits.

name: Ledger Reckoning (Tính Sổ)
rule: A Physical hit that deals more for every different status the foe bears: +4 points of L5 each. The payoff for a status collector.

name: Writ of Reckoning (Thúc Nợ Trạng)
rule: A Physical hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s and Withering (healing taken -50 %) for 2 pulses. The answer to a healer.

name: Quench (Tôi Thiết)
rule: No hit. Only while you bear Sealed Meridian: cleanses curses with the seal tag from you.

name: Plain Sword Cut (Bình Kiếm Trảm)
rule: A plain Physical sword hit.

name: Broad Saber Sweep (Khoan Đao Tảo)
rule: A heavy Physical saber hit.

name: Iron Fist (Thiết Quyền)
rule: A fast, cheap Physical fist hit.

name: Spear Thrust (Thương Đột)
rule: A Physical spear hit.

name: Bleeding Slash (Xuất Huyết Trảm)
rule: A Physical saber hit that opens 1 Bleed stack.

name: Sundering Cut (Phá Giáp Trảm)
rule: A Physical sword hit that lays 1 Sundered stack (-150 points of resistance to the hit's type, up to 3 stacks).

name: Binding Thrust (Phược Thích)
rule: A Physical spear hit that lays Exposed (all resistance -100 points) for 3 pulses.

name: Iron Nail (Thiết Đinh)
rule: Fires only while the foe bears Exposed. The main damage of a curse build: the hit that waits for the board to fill.

name: Shattering Fist (Toái Quyền)
rule: A heavy Physical fist hit that strips up to 4 stacks from the foe's largest buff pile.

name: Haft Sweep (Côn Tảo)
rule: A Physical spear hit that delays the foe's art timers by 0.5 s (once a pulse); delays fall off.

name: Chain Sword (Liên Hoàn Kiếm)
rule: A Physical sword hit; whenever it crits (at most 2 times a pulse) your other arts' timers run 0.5 s shorter. Crits chain the whole kit.

name: Reaping Saber (Cát Đao)
rule: A heavy Physical saber hit; if it leaves the foe at 8 % health or less, the foe falls.
